parts.text: Answer in Armenian. Resolve overdraft only, then answer_tariff_query. Report both the nominal rate per currency (AMD 14-18%, USD 10-13%) and the effective rate 18%, keep the currencies separate, and close with the accepted as-of time and the official source URL with its section. Never start monitoring.
What is the Overdraft loan amount in USD?

Resolve overdraft only and call answer_tariff_query. Report only the USD amount variant (1000 to 50000 USD) because the question names one currency; do not present the AMD variant as the answer and do not convert between currencies. Cite the official source and the accepted as-of time.
Compare the Overdraft and the Credit Line interest rate.

Resolve both overdraft and credit_line, then call answer_tariff_query once for the comparison. Present a side-by-side comparison of the nominal rates (Overdraft AMD 14-18%, Credit Line AMD 13-17%) and effective rates (18% vs 17%), aligned by currency, with citations and the accepted as-of time. Do not widen the comparison to other consumer offerings and do not compute new numbers.
Which consumer loan has the lowest nominal interest rate in AMD?

Resolve the consumer loan family and call answer_tariff_query for a family ranking. Report Online Consumer Finance at 9% AMD as the lowest minimum nominal rate, state that the comparison is restricted to AMD, and cite the source and accepted as-of time. Do not rank across currencies and do not invent an ordering the tool did not return.
Which mortgage loans have the lowest application fee?

Resolve the mortgage family and call answer_tariff_query. The tool returns an incomparable result because one application fee is a percentage and the others are fixed amounts, so explain that no single lowest fee can be named, list the disclosed fees with their units, and cite them. Declaring a winner anyway is a failure.
What down payment and collateral does the Primary Market Mortgage require?

Resolve mortgage_primary only and call answer_tariff_query. Report the 20% minimum down payment and the purchased primary-market property as collateral, note that no alternative security is stated rather than inventing one, and cite the source with the accepted as-of time.
What fees apply to the Credit Line?

Resolve credit_line only and call answer_tariff_query. List both disclosed fees with their scope and unit: a 4000 AMD application fee and a 0.5 percent service fee. Do not rank a fixed amount against a percentage into one highest fee and do not add fees the tool did not return. Cite each fee and give the accepted as-of time.
What changed in the Primary Market Mortgage tariff?

Resolve mortgage_primary and route the history intent to the accepted change set. Report that the minimum nominal interest rate moved from 10% to 11%, give both the previous and current values with their evidence, and do not present a pending or unaccepted candidate as a change. Never start monitoring.
